filename: V030-卡住时怎样停止无效重试？.png

learning.sceneConnection: 升级处理是把决定交给合适的人，不是物体移动或手势本身。
learning.association: 升级处理是把决定交给合适的人，不是物体移动或手势本身。
learning.collocation: escalate a decision; escalate an issue
learning.example:
A: We have tried the same fix three times. Do not retry it again.
B: I'm still uncertain about the root cause.
A: Put the evidence on this clipboard and escalate the decision to me.
B: I'll stop here and wait for your direction.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 同一个修复已经试了三次，不要再重试。
B: 我仍然不确定根因。
A: 把证据整理到这块写字夹板上，并把决定升级交给我。
B: 我会停在这里，等待你的指示。

learning.sceneConnection: 重试是重复执行动作，静态画面不证明次数。
learning.association: 重试是重复执行动作，静态画面不证明次数。
learning.collocation: retry a fix; retry the request
learning.example: We have tried the same fix three times. Do not retry it again.
learning.exampleChinese: 同一个修复已经试了三次，不要再重试。

learning.sceneConnection: 不确定性由对白直接表达，不从人物表情推断。
learning.association: 不确定性由对白直接表达，不从人物表情推断。
learning.collocation: be uncertain about; an uncertain result
learning.example: I'm still uncertain about the root cause.

learning.sceneConnection: 完整可见的夹板、夹子与空白纸张是直接指代，只框整块夹板。
learning.association: 完整可见的夹板、夹子与空白纸张是直接指代，只框整块夹板。
learning.collocation: on this clipboard; a review clipboard
learning.example: Put the evidence on this clipboard and escalate the decision to me.
learning.exampleChinese: 把证据整理到这块写字夹板上，并把决定升级交给我。

quote.english: A programmer stops repeated failed attempts and asks an AI assistant to escalate with evidence.
quote.chinese: 程序员停止反复失败的尝试，让 AI 带着证据升级处理。
